16 For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek. (Romans 1:16 KJV)

Just what is the Gospel of Christ? The Gospel is the “nearly to good to be true” news of what Jesus did for us who believe in Him. It is a Gospel of Grace through faith in Jesus (Ephesians 2:8). It is not what we do or have done for God that gives us our salvation, but it is entirely through the Grace of God (Ephesians 2:5), who justifies us through our faith in Jesus. Most churches do not properly teach the Gospel, and so most Christians are not getting the full benefit from their salvation.

The Gospel includes healing, deliverance, prosperity, answered prayer, joy, peace, love – they are all included in our salvation and born again experience. You do not have to keep asking God to give you any of those things, as you already have them in your born again spirits (Ephesians 1:3). All you need to do is to learn how to get them out of your spirits into your flesh, so that you can enjoy them here and now, not wait until you get to heaven. What a shame that religion is not telling us about what all we have in our born again spirits, so that we can utilize it now. Jesus came to give us life more abundantly – now (John 10:10). Thank you Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
